description: This file defines the AdminFilter class, a Spring MVC interceptor extending HandlerInterceptorAdapter. It manages administrative session validation, user and store retrieval, language setting, and dynamic menu loading for admin pages in a web application.

classes.name: AdminFilter
classes.description: A Spring MVC interceptor for handling admin session validation, menu setup, and language preferences in the admin interface.

methods.name: preHandle
methods.description: Intercepts HTTP requests to perform authentication, load user/store/language info, initialize menus from JSON, and set request attributes for admin pages.

methods.name: getMenu
methods.description: Recursively constructs Menu objects from parsed JSON data.
